normalized.title: Complex Systems and Occupy Wall Street
normalized.summary: November 18, 2011 I am impressed by the Occupy Wall Street (OWS) movement and its objectives. As the head of an institute whose work is to bring to light central issues at stake nationally and globally, I would like to express my support and help clarify the scientific basis of their demands.
